## reference · YouTube SEO AI citation study 2026

* YouTube has over 2.7 billion monthly active users and consistently ranks among the top 10 most cited domains in AI-generated search responses.
* 5.54% of AI citations originate from social media and video domains, with YouTube representing 31.8% of social media citations.
* YouTube is the 2nd biggest social media source used by AI, with Reddit making up 46.4% of social media citations.
* Perplexity and Google AI Overviews drive the majority of YouTube citations, with 38.7% and 36.6% respectively.
* 94% of AI citations go to long-form YouTube videos, not Shorts.
* Views, likes, and subscribers show near-zero correlation with citation frequency.
* Timestamped YouTube citations appear only within Google's AI platforms, with 73% appearing in Google AI Overviews and 27% in Google AI Mode.
* One structured video can generate multiple AI citations, with 78% of timestamped videos being cited repeatedly.
* Social media citation share varies by AI Search engine, with each platform applying different retrieval and citation logic.
* Google AI Mode and AI Overviews prioritize YouTube, while Perplexity and ChatGPT prioritize Reddit.
* Microsoft Copilot and Gemini show near-zero YouTube citation volume, making YouTube a low-leverage tactic there.
* Long-form YouTube videos are where AI citations happen, with 94% of AI citations going to long-form videos.
* YouTube Shorts play a minimal but platform-specific role in AI, with most citations coming from Google AI Mode and Google AI Overviews.
* YouTube timestamps are only important for Google's AI platforms, with 73% of timestamped citations appearing in Google AI Overviews.

Sources: https://otterly.ai/blog/youtube-ai-citation-study-2026/
